description: This file defines the VisualTheme class, which models a visual theme in a widget rendering system. It includes properties like theme ID, display name, description, and screenshots, and methods to access these properties and initialize from XML.

classes.name: VisualTheme
classes.description: A class representing a visual theme with properties such as ID, display name, description, and screenshots, initialized from XML.

methods.name: getVisualThemeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the visual theme.

methods.name: getScreenshots
methods.description: Returns the list of screenshot locations.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the expanded display name based on the provided context.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the expanded description based on the provided context.

methods.name: VisualTheme
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a VisualTheme object from an XML element and a ModelTheme.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the VisualTheme object.
